blurb: Guests charter the La Vela, a Viking Widebody luxury motor yacht with 4 staterooms and 3 full bathrooms. The yacht features a Gulfstar design salon set up as a lounge with a liquor bar and big screen television. It includes a $100,000 audio system, fog machine, dance floor, and laser light show, with climate-controlled areas.
